#| echo: false

import os
import pandas as pd
import plotly.express as px

from bioreport.config import load_config
from bioreport.utils.render_output import show_figure, show_table

report_config = load_config(os.environ["REPORT_CONFIG"])
input_key = report_module["params"]["input_key"]
measurements = pd.read_csv(report_config["input_files"][input_key])
required_columns = {"sample", "group", "value"}
missing_columns = required_columns - set(measurements.columns)
if missing_columns:
    raise ValueError(f"Measurements CSV is missing columns: {', '.join(sorted(missing_columns))}")

show_table(measurements)
figure = px.box(measurements, x="group", y="value", points="all", hover_name="sample")
figure.update_layout(xaxis_title="Group", yaxis_title="Measurement")
show_figure(figure)
